data.title: Robinhood Sees More Flows Into Bitcoin ETFs
data.description: Robinhood Senior Vice President and General Manager of Crypto Johann Kerbrat talks about investor sentiment around crypto, a hack of Coldcard wallets and how the business is expanding in the United Kingdom. He speaks on "Bloomberg Crypto."
